IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##LASTSEENPROVIDER') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##LASTSEENPROVIDER
CREATE TABLE ##LASTSEENPROVIDER
(
CLCL_ID			VARCHAR(100)
,PRPR_NAME		VARCHAR(100)
,PROVIDER_ADDRESS	VARCHAR(200)
,PROVIDERPHONE		VARCHAR(50)
)

----Use servicing provider's service address location
UPDATE LSP
SET           LSP.PRPR_NAME = PRPR.PRPR_NAME
              ,LSP.PROVIDER_ADDRESS = PRAD_ADDR1+' '+PRAD_ADDR2+' '+PRAD_ADDR3+' '+PRAD_CITY+' '+PRAD_STATE+' '+PRAD_ZIP 
              ,LSP.PROVIDERPHONE = CASE 
									   WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_PHONE) > 0 THEN PRAD.PRAD_PHONE + CASE WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT) > 0 THEN 'X' + PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT ELSE '' END
									   ELSE ''
                                   END
FROM   ##LASTSEENPROVIDER LSP
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM CLCL(NOLOCK)
ON     LSP.CLCL_ID = CLCL.CLCL_ID
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR(NOLOCK)
ON     CLCL.PRPR_ID = PRPR.PRPR_ID 
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS PRAD(NOLOCK)
ON     CLCL.PRAD_TYPE = PRAD.PRAD_TYPE  ---- Pulling address from claim
AND    PRAD.PRAD_TERM_DT >= GETDATE()


--  Else use primary address
UPDATE LSP
SET           LSP.PRPR_NAME = PRPR.PRPR_NAME
        ,LSP.PROVIDER_ADDRESS = PRAD.PRAD_ADDR1+' '+PRAD.PRAD_ADDR2+' '+PRAD.PRAD_ADDR3+' '+PRAD.PRAD_CITY+' '+PRAD.PRAD_STATE+' '+PRAD.PRAD_ZIP 
		,LSP.PROVIDERPHONE = CASE 
								WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_PHONE) > 0 THEN PRAD.PRAD_PHONE + CASE WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT) > 0 THEN 'X' + PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT ELSE '' END
								ELSE ''
							 END
FROM   ##LASTSEENPROVIDER LSP                                               
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM CLCL(NOLOCK)
ON     LSP.CLCL_ID = CLCL.CLCL_ID
AND    (LSP.PRPR_NAME IS NULL  OR LSP.PRPR_NAME = '')
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR(NOLOCK)
ON     CLCL.PRPR_ID = PRPR.PRPR_ID
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS PRAD(NOLOCK)
ON     PRAD.PRAD_ID = PRPR.PRAD_ID
AND    PRPR.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM = PRAD.PRAD_TYPE
AND    PRAD.PRAD_TERM_DT >= GETDATE()

IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##LASTSEENPROVIDER') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##LASTSEENPROVIDER
CREATE TABLE ##LASTSEENPROVIDER
(
	CLCL_ID				VARCHAR(100)
	,PRPR_NAME			VARCHAR(100)
	,PROVIDER_ADDRESS	VARCHAR(200)
	,PROVIDERPHONE		VARCHAR(50)
)

DECLARE @EnvironName VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @RootPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @FolderPath VARCHAR(8000)

SET @EnvironName = (SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'Environment')
SET @RootPath = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'RootPath' AND EnvironName = @EnvironName),'')
SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDT..EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'OverdueExport')
SET @FolderPath = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'FolderPath')

SELECT @RootPath + @FolderPath AS RootPathFolder
